name: com.magithar.socketio-unity
description: Real-time multiplayer infrastructure for Unity — lobby systems, player sync, and live backend over Socket.IO v4. WebGL-ready.

samples.description: Simple chat demo — recommended starting point.
Multiplayer lobby with host migration, session identity, and reconnect recovery.
End-to-end lobby-to-match flow combining Lobby and PlayerSync in a single scene.
Hybrid architecture combining Socket.IO backend with Mirror in-scene networking. Requires Mirror (via UPM) and the Lobby sample to be imported first.
